title: Address R9 wake-recovery persistence stamps, unused retry wrappers and coverage gaps
outcome: Resolve the four non-blocking Low groups from the R9 Claude review: stamp durable mailbox ACK settlement and covering-owner reorder before live persistence; remove dead retry wrappers without warning suppression; cover rebuilt AdmissionRetry ownership changes during held WAL and live-worker durability; replace tautological route-snapshot assertions with meaningful behavior checks.
acceptance: Durable ACK receipt settlement and failed-delivery covering-owner reorder advance the session mutation stamp before commit; a live persist-worker test reads the correct SQLite row after each operation.
Unused admission retry dispatch wrapper is removed and bind retry wrapper is removed or test-only; no dead-code warning suppression is added.
A rebuilt AdmissionRetry owner is tested against independent changes during its actual held WAL; route snapshot tests assert behavior rather than restating fixture construction.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher and the maintained full gate passes on the exact final input.
